title: The composer's commands, files and `!` commands
description: GET /api/v1/conversations/<id>/commands and GET /api/v1/workspaces/commands?workspace_id= (Pi's own command list, from the running Pi or a short-lived list-only Pi), GET /api/v1/workspaces/files?workspace_id=[&query=] and GET /api/v1/workspaces/file_preview?workspace_id=&path= (the workspace's file names and one bounded preview, read as the person), and POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/bash and /abort_bash (a typed `!` or `!!` command relayed to Pi as RPC bash). The conversation status carries the command's state as `bash`.

command.description: One entry of Pi's get_commands without its source path. terminal_only: the command opens Pi's own terminal dialogs, so the browser lists it but cannot run it.

commandList.description: answered_by: running (the conversation's Pi) or helper (a list-only Pi that started no conversation and wrote no session).

relativePath.description: A path relative to the workspace root, never absolute and without empty, . or .. parts.

fileList.description: At most 200 matches; without a query changed files first. truncated: the workspace or the matches had more. An unavailable list is an error, never an empty list.

filePreview.description: Git's diff of a changed file, or the first lines of another regular file beneath the workspace; at most 40 lines and 8 KiB.

bashRequest.description: The command text without its `!`; exclude_from_context is `!!`: Pi records the output but never gives it to the model.

bashReply.description: running: written to the running Pi. held: Pi is not running yet; the command runs once the Pi this starts is ready. accepted: the reply of abort_bash.

bashStatus.description: The conversation status field `bash`: the last `!` command of this daemon incarnation, or null. not_started: its Pi did not start, or it was taken back before it ran; it is never run later. uncertain: Pi ended or the write was lost before the outcome was known.
